title: centrapalus africanus
intro: Centrapalus africanus, commonly known as African Cent, is a plant species native to South Africa, belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of African Cent include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of African Cent include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
